CANONICAL_NAME.value: Indirect self-tuning regulator (Astrom & Wittenmark, Adaptive Control ch. 3): RLS with forgetting factor estimates the plant online, pole-placement (R,S,T) recomputed every step -- a MATLAB implementation, run under Octave

value.lineage: The self-tuning regulator (Astrom & Wittenmark 1973; textbook Adaptive Control 1989/1995, Example 3.5-style: model-following with zero cancellation): a recursive-least-squares estimator with forgetting tracks the plant's a1,a2,b0,b1; the controller polynomials R,S,T are re-derived from the estimates each sample so the closed loop follows the reference model Am/Bm. This is a student's faithful implementation of the textbook algorithm (MATLAB, 2020) with the true plant's parameters drawn as reference lines -- the ORACLE the estimates converge to (a1=-1.6065, a2=0.6065, b0=0.1065, b1=0.0902).

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: adaptive pole-placement control of an unknown plant

value.built_to: control a plant whose parameters are unknown by identifying them online and redesigning the controller at every step
value.pressure: unknown/drifting plant, the need for the closed loop to match a specified reference model
value.success_means: the estimated parameters converge to the plant's and the output follows the reference model

value.pressure: parameter uncertainty; excitation must be rich enough for identification
value.failure_condition: estimator divergence or controller bursting when excitation vanishes (the known STR hazard)
